Introduction to The Cat in the Hat on Waze

According to an official Google blog post, Waze is introducing a new navigation experience featuring characters from 'The Cat in the Hat,' which arrives in theaters on November 6.

Voice Navigation and Features

Comedy icon Bill Hader voices the Cat for this experience. Drivers can expect turn-by-turn directions that include Seussian rhymes, optimism, and playful sound effects designed to alter the driving experience.

Moods and Vehicle Customization

Users can select the 'Delightful' Mood, which features the Cat's red-and-white stovepipe hat, or the 'Impulsive' Mood represented by Thing 1. Additionally, the navigation arrow can be swapped for the Cat's vehicle, the jet-powered Magical Couch.

Global Availability

The experience is available globally in English. Users can access it by opening Waze and tapping the banner in their menu or activating it directly.
